        LD (HL),A
PL52B   LD A,(DE)
        INC DE
        CP ")"
        JR Z,PL56
        LD C,A
        LD A,(DE)
        PUSH HL
        PUSH DE
        LD D,A
        LD E,0
        LD HL,TBSIGN
PL53    LD A,(HL)
        INC HL
        CP C
        LD A,(HL)
        INC HL
        JR NZ,PL54
        CP #20
        JR Z,PL55
        CP D
        JR Z,PL55
PL54    INC E
        BIT 5,E
        JR Z,PL53
        POP DE
        POP HL
        SCF
        RET

PL55    LD A,E
        POP DE
        POP HL
        CP #08
        JR C,PL58
        CP #0C
        INC DE
        JR C,PL58
        DEC DE
        CP #0F
        JR C,PL58
        CP #17
        JR C,PL59A
        INC A; NZ
        DEC DE
PL56    SET 3,(HL)
        RET

PL57    SUB #0D
PL58    RRCA:RRCA:RRCA:RRCA
        LD C,A
        JR PL51

PL59A   SUB #0F
        OR #F0
        LD (IX),A
        PUSH IX
        POP HL
        INC IX
        JR PL52B

PL60    CP "#"
        JP Z,PL63
        CP #22
        JP Z,PL70
        CP "%"
        JP Z,PL73
        CP #30
        JP C,PL77
        CP #3A
        JP NC,PL77
        SUB #30; DECIMAL
        LD HL,0
PL61    ADD HL,HL
        RET C
        LD B,H
        LD C,L
        ADD HL,HL
        RET C
        ADD HL,HL
        RET C
        ADD HL,BC
        RET C
        LD C,A
        LD B,0
        ADD HL,BC
        RET C
        LD A,(DE)
        SUB #30
        JR C,PL62
        CP #0A
        INC DE
        JR C,PL61
        DEC DE
PL62    LD (IX),L : INC IX
        LD B,2
        LD A,H
        OR A
        RET Z
        LD B,6
PL62A   LD (IX),H : INC IX
        RET

PL63    LD HL,0; #
        LD B,0
PL64    LD A,(DE)
        SUB #30
        JR C,PL67
        CP #0A
        JR C,PL66
        CP #30
        JR C,PL65
        SUB #20
PL65    SUB 7
        CP 10
        JR C,PL67
        CP #10
        JR NC,PL67
PL66    ADD HL,HL
        RET C
        ADD HL,HL
        RET C
        ADD HL,HL
        RET C
        ADD HL,HL
        RET C
        OR L
        LD L,A
        INC B
        INC DE
        JR PL64

PL67    LD A,B
        OR A
        SCF
        RET Z
        LD (IX),L : INC IX
        CP 4
        JR NC,PL68
        LD B,1
        LD A,H
        OR A
        RET Z
PL68    LD B,5
        JR PL62A

PL70    LD A,(DE);   "
        INC DE
        OR A
        SCF
        RET Z
        CP #22
        JR NZ,PL71
        LD A,(DE)

        CP #22
        SCF
        RET NZ

        LD H,0

        INC DE

        SCF
        RET Z
        CP #22
        JR NZ,PL72

        JR NZ,PL72A

PL72    LD H,L

        LD A,(DE)

        CP #22
        SCF
        RET NZ
PL72A   LD B,4

PL73    LD HL,0; %
        LD B,0
PL74    LD A,(DE)
        CP #30

        CP #31
        JR NZ,PL76

PL75    ADC HL,HL:RET C
        INC B

PL76    LD A,B
        OR A
        LD B,7
        JR NZ,PL72B
        SCF:RET

PL77    LD C,#00
        CALL PLBL
        LD B,3
        RET

FTK     PUSH BC
        PUSH DE
        CALL FTK8
        JR NC,FTK7
        LD BC,#2020
        LD H,B
        LD L,A
        CALL FTK9
        JR NC,FTK1
        LD H,A
        CALL FTK9
        JR NC,FTK1
        LD C,A
        CALL FTK9
        JR NC,FTK1
        LD B,A
        CALL FTK9
        JR C,FTK7
FTK1    PUSH DE
        EX DE,HL
        LD HL,TBTK
        LD A,9
FTK2    EX AF,AF
        LD A,E : CP (HL) : INC HL
        JR NZ,FTK3
        LD A,D : CP (HL) : INC HL
        JR NZ,FTK4
        LD A,C : CP (HL) : INC HL
        JR NZ,FTK5
        LD A,B : CP (HL) : INC HL
        JR NZ,FTK6
        EX AF,AF
        LD B,0
        CP #41
        JR C,FTK2A
        CP #44
        LD B,#2B
        JR C,FTK2A
        LD B,#31
        JR Z,FTK2A
        CP #49
        LD B,0
        JR NC,FTK2A
        LD B,#F3
FTK2A   ADD A,B
        POP DE
        POP BC
        POP BC
        OR A
        RET

FTK3    INC HL
FTK4    INC HL
FTK5    INC HL
FTK6    EX AF,AF
        INC A
        CP #8C
        JR NZ,FTK2
        POP BC
FTK7    POP DE
        POP BC
        SCF
        RET

FTK8    PUSH BC
        LD B,8
        JR FTK10

FTK9    PUSH BC
        LD B,9
FTK10   PUSH HL
        LD A,(DE)
        LD HL,TBSGN1
FTK11   CP (HL)
        JR Z,FTK13
        INC L
        INC L
        DJNZ FTK11
        CP #61
        JR C,FTK12
        CP #7B
        JR NC,FTK12
        SUB #20
FTK12   INC DE
        SCF
FTK13   POP HL
        POP BC
        RET

; A-FIRST ; (DE)->(IX)
; C #80 OR #00
; C ERR NC O'K
; DE-ADR NEXT
; A-NDEF

PLBL    CP "."
        JR Z,PLBL2
        CP "="
        JR Z,PLBL3
        CP "$"
        JR Z,PLBL5
        CP #60
        JR C,PLBL1
        SUB #20
PLBL1   SUB #41
        RET C
        ADD A,#C0
        RET C
        CP #DA
        JR C,PLBL10
        SCF
        RET

PLBL2   LD A,#DA
        JR PLBL10

PLBL3   LD A,(DE)
        SUB #30
        JR C,PLBL4
        CP #08
        JR NC,PLBL4
        BIT 7,C
        SCF
        RET NZ
        INC A
        CALL PL8A
        INC DE
        OR A
        RET

PLBL4   LD A,#DB
        JR PLBL10

PLBL5   BIT 7,C
        SCF
        RET NZ
        XOR A:JP PL8A

PLBL6   LD A,(DE)
        CP "_"
        JR NZ,PLBL7
        LD A,#0B
        JR PLBL8

PLBL7   SUB #30
        JR C,PLBL11
        CP 10
        JR C,PLBL8
        SUB 5
        CP #0C
        JR C,PLBL11
        CP #26
        JR C,PLBL8
        SUB 6
        CP #26
        JR C,PLBL11
        CP #40
        JR NC,PLBL11
PLBL8   BIT 7,C
        JR Z,PLBL9
        RES 7,C
        OR #40
PLBL9   INC DE
PLBL10  CALL PL8A
        INC C
        BIT 3,C
        JR Z,PLBL6
        SCF
        RET

PLBL11  LD A,C
        AND #07
        DEC A
        JR NZ,PLBL13
        BIT 7,C
        LD A,#0A
        JR Z,PLBL12
        OR #40
PLBL12  CALL PL8A
PLBL13  SET 7,(IX-1)
        OR A
        RET

TBTK

_DB "NEG RLD RRD INF RETIRETN    "
_DB "B   C   D   E   H   L   (HL)A   "
_DB "HX  LX  HY  LY  BC  DE  HL  SP  "
_DB "    DEFBDEFWDEFSAF' XH  XL  YH  "
_DB "YL      LD  INC DEC EX  JR  DJNZ"
_DB "JP  CALLRET POP PUSHADD ADC SUB "
_DB "SBC AND OR  XOR CP  IN  OUT BIT "
_DB "RES SET RLC RRC RL  RR  SLA SRA "
_DB "SLI SRL IM  RST DB  DW  DS  IX  "
_DB "IY  (BC)(DE)I   R   AF  (SP)(C) "
_DB "NZ  Z   NC  C   PO  PE  P   M   "
_DB "INCLINCBREPTENDRIF  IFU IFNUIFD "
_DB "IFNDELSEEIF ENDM"
